name: APOLLO glioma Raman maps (Lita et al. 2024)
description: Raman maps of 59 glioma tissue slides from 46 patients, 1,738 bands from 50 to 3,400 cm⁻¹. Only the spectra the authors' DBSCAN tumour separation marks as tumour are kept. Target: DNA-methylation subtype LGm1-6. Group ids are patients.
